answer: Each agent stakes a bond only its own operator can withdraw, and every attestation is signed with a key whose bond is slashed to zero the moment two keys under one operator make contradictory claims. A sybil farm must fund every alias: ten thousand identities cost ten thousand locked stakes, and each slash carves a canyon into the attacker's budget while honest nodes feel only a slow glacier of cooldown before withdrawal. Since slashing proceeds go to the verifiers who caught it, policing pays better than cheating, and forgery is a climb toward a zenith of capital that never returns.
